line.t: Since you came, this family has known no peace!
Ma, I only told the truth about the car.
Amara, not now. Let me handle my family.
Your family? I thought I was becoming your family.
My daughter will not beg to be accepted.

vo.t: Tell Tobi's mother: the engagement is off.

line.t: I chose silence to protect them. And I lost her.
Sir, please. Give me one week. I'll bring the truth.
One week. After that, don't come back.
